args.title: Fix export filename date to use local time instead of UTC
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Change the function formatExportFilename so that it uses the local date rather than the date from at.toISOString(), which is UTC. This prevents the export filename from showing the next UTC date in certain time zones in the evening.
